description_en: Deletes a user group from a bastion host
description_zh: 删除单个堡垒机用户组
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id '１' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to delete the user group.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除用户组的堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to delete the user group.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除用户组的堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group that you want to delete.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the ID of the user group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的用户组ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id
